chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn, from Safwan, from al-Ala', from Muhammad ibn Muslim, who said:

I heard him (peace be upon him) saying: 'When you do not find water and intend Tayammum, then delay the Tayammum until the end of the time (of prayer). So if the water is missed, the earth is not missed.'
ai.seo_question: When should one perform Tayammum if water is not available?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi emphasizes the principle of *istibra* (verification) by advising believers to delay Tayammum until the end of the prayer time to confirm the genuine unavailability of water. It highlights the Shia scholarly view that the earth remains perpetually accessible, making the loss of water the critical condition for the substitution. This ruling ensures that the superior act of using water is not abandoned prematurely due to haste or doubt.
